## 13. The decision

- S3, TOO THIN: every cell fitted - does not fire
- S2, NEVER SENDS: does not fire - V_XXII holds 12 measures, and 2 * P(NONE_XXII) < 1: P(NONE_XXII) 32.9 % FITTED n=110 m=12 95% [3.7 %, 95.2 %] BOOT
- S1, FAR MORE: does not fire - 166 * E[hits] >= 45 * E[named]: precision 87.0 % FITTED n=110 m=34 95% [70.9 %, 99.1 %] BOOT against B1's 27.1 % (45 of 166)
- B1's 27.1 % lies below the precision's BOOT interval [70.9 %, 99.1 %].
